operation_proposals.source_operation: GCN training and graph-convolution message passing
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog represents learned projections and attention, but no graph-convolution or adjacency-based message-passing operation.
The catalog can join or correspond data but does not construct a graph with nodes, edges, and adjacency structure.
The catalog has no operation for graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, or adjacency-based state updates.
Existing normalize is defined for numerical values, while the element concerns normalization of textual definitions and descriptions.
The catalog has no graph-convolution or graph-message-passing primitive.
The catalog does not represent construction of a subgraph with selected nodes and edges.
